LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepColonistsWeaponsTip: Keep weapons of player controlled pawns (colonists) with them when they are downed.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepColonistsInventoryTip: Keep inventory items (non-weapons and non-equipment) of player controlled pawns (colonists) with them when they are downed.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepWeaponsAndInventoryOfDe: Keep weapons and inventory of dead colonists
Apply the two colonist options above also when a colonist dies instead of dropping everything. The weapons and inventory options decide what is kept.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepOtherPawnsWeaponsTip: Keep weapons of non-player pawns (e.g. raiders) with them when they are downed.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepOtherPawnsInventoryTip: Keep inventory items (non-weapons and non-equipment) of non-player pawns with them when they are downed.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepWeaponsAndInventoryOfOt: Keep weapons and inventory of other dead pawns
Apply the two non-player pawn options above also when such a pawn dies instead of dropping everything. The weapons and inventory options decide what is kept. Overpowered against tribal raids.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.DebugLoggingTip: Log every prevented or allowed drop to the game log: pawn, weapon, faction and the decision taken. For verifying behavior and bug reports. Dev mode only.
